policies.title: Djiboutian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule places Djibouti in its Prior to Arrival visa category.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Djiboutian passport holder visiting Grenada; the schedule defines 'Prior To Arrival' as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
The Embassy's live visitor page confirms requirements depend on citizenship; work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside scope.
Admission remains subject to Grenada immigration control and the requirements of the competent mission or consulate.

policies.title: Djiboutian ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule names Djibouti in the authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular processing unless a separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Djiboutian passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate valid third-country visa or residence waiver.
The Embassy requires an authorized-visa applicant to appear in person at the consulate before travel; approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, special documents, consular-jurisdiction requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Appear in person and submit the listed authorized-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Do not finalize travel arrangements until the visa has been granted.

policies.title: Djiboutian ordinary passports: North Macedonia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: North Macedonia's live Foreign Ministry checker returns that Djiboutian foreign citizens need a visa, and its procedure requires pre-travel application through a competent representation.
conditions: The Foreign Ministry's nationality checker returns 'Needed' for Djibouti.
Separate third-country-document entry waivers, if applicable, are not an ordinary Djiboutian-passport baseline.
Work, residence, transit, special travel documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: North Macedonia visa application procedure
steps: Apply through the competent North Macedonian diplomatic-consular representation before the intended trip.
Submit the application no more than six months and at least 15 days before travel.
